_comment: Knobs for the quiz word build (python backend/scripts/build_lexicon.py). Everything that decides whether a Qur'anic word is fair to quiz on lives here, not in the script.
_juz_api: The only thing not already on this machine: which ayahs each juz holds. Fetched once and kept in data/quran/juz.json, so every later run is offline.
_anki_decks: Anki decks of everyday vocabulary, read for their verb and noun cards. Each sits in backend/data/, stripped of its media (audio/images are not vocabulary data and are not kept). Read in this order, each merging into what came before, so a word two decks both teach becomes one row keeping the first one's English; which is why the newer, per-book decks are listed before the old bulk one covering all four books at once: a word they share should keep the newer deck's wording, not be overwritten back to the older one. bayna-yadayk.apkg is read last and so only fills in book 2, which no newer per-book deck yet replaces. A word any of them teaches that is already in one of the Qur'anic sets is left out rather than merged: it is already being asked there.
_governed_particles: A deck card writes the preposition a verb governs beside it, اِعْتَدَى (على). That is a note about the word, not part of how it is spelt, so it is removed. An aside that is not one of these particles is left alone: كَادَ (يكاد) and كَادَ (يكيد) are two verbs and the aside is the only thing telling them apart. Matched on letters, so every vocalisation of a particle is covered by one entry.
_filter: A word-by-word gloss is often a fragment, '(is)', 'and', 'O'. Those make impossible questions, so they are dropped rather than shown.
_gloss_shape: A word-by-word gloss describes the word in its place, so it drags its neighbours in: لَبِثَ reads 'and not he delayed' where it happens to follow a wa. A lemma is glossed from its cleanest reading in the whole Qur'an, and a word with no clean reading anywhere is dropped rather than asked as a clause.
_lead_fragments: A gloss starting with one of these is carrying the word before it, 'on the bank' is the bank with an 'ala stuck to its front. 'to' is not here: 'to bring forth' is the English of a verb, not a leak.
_pronouns: A thing does not have a person inside it: 'their fingers' is fingers with an attached pronoun, not a word to learn. Verbs are exempt, 'He guides' is simply how English writes a conjugated verb.
_stopwords: Glosses that are pure grammar. Compared after the gloss is cleaned and lower-cased.
